ETag.description: The resource's version, quoted (for example `"3"`). Send it back as If-Match on the next change.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is a replay of the first response for the same Idempotency-Key; absent on the first.

Link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page (`rel="next"`); absent on the last page.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The request's correlation id: echoed from the request header when valid, otherwise generated.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page. Pass it as the `cursor` query parameter.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: the request is malformed or a field is invalid; `errors` maps each field to its messages.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the caller lacks the permission (code `auth.forbidden`).

NotFound.description: Not Found: no such resource, or it is outside the caller's scope, or its module is disabled (code `module.disabled`).

PayloadTooLarge.description: Payload Too Large: a request with an Idempotency-Key is too large to fingerprint (code `idempotency.body_too_large`).

PreconditionFailed.description: Precondition Failed: the If-Match version is stale; read the resource again.

PreconditionRequired.description: Precondition Required: the If-Match header is missing.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service Unavailable: a dependency is briefly unavailable; retry after Retry-After seconds.

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests: wait for Retry-After seconds.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Unprocessable Entity: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body (code `idempotency.key_reused`).

AgeingBucketDto.description: Open claims whose age falls in a band: `0-2`, `3-7`, `8-14` or `15+` days.

AnswerClaimInfoRequest.description: Body of the claimant's answer to an open information request.

AuditLogDto.description: One audit row as the read API returns it. Values were masked when the row was written (ADR-010), so nothing here can be un-masked. ErrorType, ErrorMessage and DurationMs are set on failure rows only (the message is an audit-safe summary: validation field names only, or the exception type name; never handler or exception text). Changes is `{ "field": { "old": ..., "new": ... } }`; Metadata holds extras such as the command name.

AuditSearchHitDto.description: One search hit. Highlights maps a field name to its text with matches wrapped in `<em>`; the rest of the text is NOT HTML-escaped, so a console must escape everything except the `em` tags before rendering. Null when the query was empty.

AuditSearchResultDto.description: EstimatedTotalHits is the engine's estimate of all matches, not the page size.

AuditTraceDto.description: The trace of one correlation id, oldest first. SpanMs is the time from the first row to the last moment any row records. Status is `failed` (a command failed or an event or delivery is dead), `pending` (an event or delivery is still waiting) or `complete`.

AuditTraceVoiceDto.description: One voice of the trace. AtMs and EndMs are milliseconds after the first row. For a command, Label is the audit action, Detail the HTTP method and route, Status the outcome and DurationMs the pipeline time (failure rows only). For an event, the event type, the outbox status and EndMs when it was relayed. For a delivery, the event type, the subscription name, the delivery status, attempts, the last HTTP status code and EndMs when it succeeded or was dead-lettered.

CheckImportDraftsRequest.description: Body of a draft check: the drafts as the reviewer has them, raw text, in the order to answer in.

ClaimCountsDto.description: Claims per status under the caller's scope and the list's filters (status excluded). Every status is present, zero included.

ClaimDto.description: The claim as returned to clients; `Version` is also sent as the `ETag`. Money is bigint minor units in `Currency`. The last group is staff-only (a caller without `CLAIMS_ALL` gets nulls): the internal reserve in particular is never shown to a claimant. `OpenInfoRequest` is filled when one claim is read, not in list rows.

ClaimExposureDto.description: The company's exposure per market and line, in the market's own currency. Amounts are bigint minor units and are NEVER added across currencies: `Totals` are per currency. `OutstandingReserveMinor` sums the reserves of open claims only; an approved claim leaves it and shows as `ApprovedNotSettled` until it is settled; rejected and settled claims are not exposure. `UnreservedOpenCount` is the open claims with no reserve yet: their exposure is unknown, so it must not be read as zero.

ClaimInfoRequestDto.description: The question the claimant is asked to answer.

ClaimInfoRequestEntryDto.description: One question put to the claimant and its answer, as listed by `GET /claims/{id}/info-requests`. `AskedBy` reads as "Claims team" to a claimant (no officer names leave the building), like the timeline. `Answer` and `AnsweredAt` are null while open.

ClaimOutcome.description: The two ways a claim under review can be decided. Read case-insensitively, so `approve` and `reject` are accepted.

ClaimSearchHitDto.description: One hit, shaped like a queue row. ClaimantName is staff-only (null for a claimant, who only ever finds their own claims).

ClaimSearchResultDto.description: EstimatedTotalHits is the engine's estimate of all matches, not the page size.

ClaimStatusCountDto.description: The number of claims in one status.

ClaimTimelineEntryDto.description: One row of a claim's history. A claimant sees the real name only for their own actions; staff actions read as "Claims team". The note is written for the claimant and never carries the reserve.

ClaimWorkloadDto.description: Who is working what, as of `AsOf` (live rows, as fresh as the last committed transaction). "Open" means still to be decided: Submitted, UnderReview or InfoRequested. Ages are in days since submission. A decision counts for the claim's assigned officer.

CreateCustomerRequest.description: Body of a customer create. `UserId` (the owner) is honoured only for callers with effective CUSTOMERS_ALL.

CreateImportedClaimRequest.description: Body of a create from a reviewed draft. `Key`, `FileName`, `FileSha256` and `Item` are echoed from the parse response; the claim fields are the normalised values from the check; `ClaimantEmail` names the account the claim belongs to; `Note` goes on the timeline.

CreateUserRequest.description: Body of a user create. `Password` is the initial password the administrator hands over (12 to 128 characters); `Roles` are role codes, at least one, each granting nothing the caller does not hold.

CreateWebhookSubscriptionRequest.description: Body of POST /webhooks/subscriptions. The secret is generated by the server.

CustomerDto.description: The customer as returned to clients. `Version` is also sent as the `ETag`.

DecideClaimRequest.description: Body of a decision. `AmountMinor` is required to approve (0 < amount <= reserve) and must be absent to reject.

DevWebhookReceiptDto.description: The sink's answer to a delivery: `accepted` the first time, `duplicate` when the event id was already seen (at-least-once delivery).

GroupDto.description: A group with the roles its members inherit and how many members it has.

ImportCheckDto.description: The verdict on one draft. `Ready`: it passes the Report an incident rules, the claimant account exists and may own claims, and the item was not imported before. `Errors` are keyed by field (camelCase), with the same messages Report an incident shows. The normalised values are what to send to create.

ImportDraftDto.description: A draft read from an email or a chat: raw text for each field (null when nothing was found) and how each value was inferred.

ImportDraftInput.description: A draft as the reviewer has it (raw text, possibly edited), sent back to be checked. Market accepts the code or the country name, line is case-insensitive, the date accepts yyyy-mm-dd or day-first d/m/yyyy.

ImportFileDto.description: What the server read from an uploaded file. A spreadsheet comes back as `Sheet` (the reviewer maps its columns in the browser); an inbox export or a chat comes back as `Drafts`. `FileSha256` identifies the upload; each row or draft carries its own key and, when that item was imported before, the claim it became.

ImportSheetRowDto.description: One data row; `Number` is the row number in the spreadsheet (the header is row 1).

ImportedClaimDto.description: One imported claim, newest first, for the Import page's "Imported" list.

ImportedRefDto.description: The claim an item already became.

MeDto.description: The caller's own identity and what they may do, for the console's navigation and permission checks. Everything here is about the authenticated user only; nothing identifies anyone else.

displayName.description: Name to show in the UI.

groups.description: Codes of the active groups the user belongs to. Sorted.

modules.description: The modules that are effectively enabled right now (switched on in configuration and in the database).

permissions.description: Effective permission codes, the same set the API enforces: role grants plus unexpired allow overrides, minus unexpired deny overrides, with permissions of disabled modules removed. Sorted.

roles.description: Codes of the active roles the user holds, directly or through an active group. Sorted.

tenantId.description: The tenant, or null when tenancy is off or the user has none.

MeModuleDto.description: An enabled module as the console's navigation needs it.

ModuleDto.description: A module as the admin API shows it: the configuration switch, the runtime (database) switch, and the result. `Effective` is true only when both are on. `Version` is the ETag.

OfficerWorkloadDto.description: One officer's queue. `MedianDaysToDecision` is over the claims decided in the last 30 days (null when there were none); `OldestOpenAgeDays` and `OldestOpenClaimId` are null when the officer holds no open claim. An officer who can handle claims but holds none is listed with zeros.

OverrideDto.description: A per-user allow or deny of one permission. `Expired` is evaluated against the clock at read time. `Version` is the ETag a later PUT or DELETE sends back in `If-Match`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, such as customer.not_found. Clients branch on this, never on the title.

correlationId.description: The request's X-Correlation-Id (echoed, or generated when the client sent none).

tenantId.description: The caller's tenant, present only when tenancy is on and the caller is authenticated.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request, for finding it in the logs.

ReceivedWebhookDto.description: One webhook the Development sink accepted: verified signature, fresh timestamp, first time this event id was seen.

RequestClaimInfoRequest.description: Body of an information request: the question the claimant must answer.

RoleDto.description: A role with every permission it grants, for a role by permission matrix. Permissions are ordered by module, then code.

RolePermissionDto.description: A granted permission code and the module that owns its resource.

SetClaimReserveRequest.description: Body of a reserve update: bigint minor units in the claim's currency (for example 125000 is 1,250.00 in a two-decimal currency).

SetSinkSecretRequest.description: Body of PUT /dev/webhook-sink/secret: the signing secret the Development sink should trust.

SubmitClaimRequest.description: Body of a claim submission. The claimant is the caller; the currency follows from `Market`.

TokenDto.description: The token response. `RefreshToken` is shown once and never stored in clear.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Body of a customer replace; the route carries the id and `If-Match` the version.

UpdateWebhookSubscriptionRequest.description: Body of PUT /webhooks/subscriptions/{id}. Requires If-Match. The secret is changed only by rotating it.

UserDto.description: A user as the admin console lists them: who, whether they can sign in, the roles assigned directly and the groups they belong to (by code). The password hash and every other credential field stay out of this type on purpose.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, such as customer.not_found. Clients branch on this, never on the title.

correlationId.description: The request's X-Correlation-Id (echoed, or generated when the client sent none).

tenantId.description: The caller's tenant, present only when tenancy is on and the caller is authenticated.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request, for finding it in the logs.

WebhookDeliveryDto.description: One delivery attempt state. No headers, no body, no secret: the clipped error is the only free text.

WebhookSubscriptionDto.description: A subscription as returned to clients. It never carries the secret; `Version` is also sent as the `ETag`.

WebhookSubscriptionSecretDto.description: The ONLY place the secret leaves the system: the response to create and to rotate. It is not stored in the clear and cannot be read again, so the caller must keep it. Use `WebhookSecretFormat` to sign and verify.

Bearer.description: Access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/token`. Permissions are looked up per request, so a role change takes effect immediately.

info.description: REST API of Fugue. Every error is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body with a stable `code`. Mutations of a versioned resource need `If-Match` with the ETag of the last read. Lists are keyset paged: follow `X-Next-Cursor`. Send `X-Correlation-Id` (and optionally `X-Saga-Id`) to correlate calls; both are echoed. Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/token` and send the access token as a Bearer token.
info.title: Fugue API

get.summary: List audit rows, newest first, keyset paged. Every filter is optional and they combine.

Full-text search over the audit trail (D-058): typo tolerant, newest first, with highlight snippets. Eventually consistent with the log (an indexer copies rows). 503 `search.unavailable` when the search engine is not configured or unreachable.

"The Score" (D-064): everything one correlation id left behind, oldest first: the audited command(s), the outbox event(s) and the webhook deliveries of those events, with times in milliseconds after the first row. 404 `audit.trace_not_found` when nothing has that id.

post.summary: Ends the session by revoking the token's whole family. Always 204.
Rotates a refresh token. The refresh token IS the credential, so this is anonymous; the per-IP rate limit applies.
Exchange an email and password for an access token and a refresh token. Rate limited per client address and per email.

get.summary: List claims, keyset paged. A claimant sees their own, newest first; staff with CLAIMS_ALL see every claim, oldest first (the work queue). Filter by `status` (repeat it or comma separate), `assigned` (me, none, any), `officerId` (staff), `minAgeDays` / `maxAgeDays` (whole days since submission, UTC, inclusive), `market`, `line` and `q` (claim number or policy number).

parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry. One quoted string (`"order-7f3a"`, with `\"` and `\\` escapes) or a plain token of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:` and `-`, 1 to 255 characters once decoded (the encoded header may be longer because of the quotes and escapes); anything else is 400 `idempotency.key_invalid`. The same key with the same body returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) for 24 hours instead of creating again; the same key with a different body is 422. A request that failed with a 4xx frees the key; one whose outcome is unknown keeps it (409). Without the header the request is not idempotent.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

tags.description: The audit log (ADR-010): read-only, newest first, keyset paged. There is no write, update or delete endpoint, and the table refuses them anyway (append-only trigger). One-liners only.
tags.name: Audit

tags.description: Token issuance. Anonymous by necessity; both rate limits run before any password work.
tags.name: Auth

tags.description: Claims: submit, queue, handle, decide and settle (W-020, D-053). One-liners only; the state machine lives in the Claim aggregate. A claimant sees only their own claims (anything else is 404, never 403) and never the internal reserve. Every mutating action after submit takes `If-Match` and answers with the claim as it now stands plus its new ETag.
tags.name: Claims

tags.description: Customers: a stateful aggregate rehearsing ETag/If-Match, keyset paging and guarded transitions. One-liners only.
tags.name: Customers

tags.description: A receiver for the signed webhooks, for ONE-process demos (ADR-011, D-040). Development only: any other environment answers 404. `POST` is anonymous on purpose (the sender has no JWT; the signature is the credential) and implements the receiver algorithm from the runbook: verify, reject stale timestamps, dedupe on the event id. Tell it the secret with `PUT .../secret`, read what arrived with `GET`.
tags.name: DevWebhookSink

tags.description: The one real endpoint of the scaffold: proves the pipeline end to end and gives the runbooks something to call.
tags.name: Diagnostics

tags.description: Groups: members inherit the group's roles. Minimal administration; every change writes a grant_audit row.
tags.name: Groups

tags.description: Intake import (item 11a): staff turn a spreadsheet, an inbox export (.eml/.mbox) or a WhatsApp chat export into DRAFT claims, review them, and create claims one by one through the normal submit path. These are FILE imports standing in for live Microsoft Graph, Gmail and WhatsApp Business connectors: no external service is called. Staff only (`CLAIMS_HANDLE`); idempotent by the item's content key; every create is audited.
tags.name: Import

tags.description: The signed-in caller's own identity and effective access. Needs no permission: every authenticated user may read their own.
tags.name: Me

tags.description: Module management (ADR-009): see the configuration, database and effective state, and flip the runtime switch.
tags.name: Modules

tags.description: Per-user permission overrides: an explicit allow or deny, optionally expiring. Deny wins over allow wins over role.
tags.name: Overrides

tags.description: Roles: what each role grants, for a role by permission matrix. Read only.
tags.name: Roles

tags.description: Users: the admin console directory and user creation. Never returns a password hash or any credential field.
tags.name: Users

tags.description: Outbound webhook subscriptions (ADR-011): CRUD plus secret rotation. The secret appears only in the create and rotate responses, never again. One-liners only; every action needs `WEBHOOKS_MANAGE` (admin by default).
tags.name: Webhooks
